Talent didn’t change my life.
Discipline did.

There were days I was motivated.
There were days I wasn’t.
But the days that mattered were the ones I still showed up.

I didn’t always feel like studying.
I didn’t always feel confident.

This year is ending in 5 days.
And I want you to pause for a second.

Not to overthink.
Not to regret.
Just to be honest with yourself.

Maybe you didn’t crack that job.
Maybe you could not be consistent.
Maybe you gave up more times than you’d like to admit.
